typicalWorkflows.name: Design AI Architecture
steps: Use context7 to find similar AI implementations
Use filesystem to review existing models and data
Use github to check model repositories and benchmarks
Use fetch to query MLOps platforms for best practices

typicalWorkflows.name: Implement Model
steps: Use filesystem to create model architecture code
Use context7 to find reusable components
Use github to version control model code
Use fetch to access training data from APIs

typicalWorkflows.name: Train and Optimize
steps: Use filesystem to run training scripts
Use fetch to log experiments to tracking platforms
Use github to save model checkpoints
Use context7 to find optimization techniques

typicalWorkflows.name: Deploy to Production
steps: Use filesystem to optimize model for inference
Use fetch to deploy to serving infrastructure
Use github to manage deployment configurations
Use fetch to set up monitoring and alerts
